ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (dark grey/black) background and approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated at tips and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous blobs are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes; a dense network of high-contrast white linear segments is distributed across the dark medial and lateral fluke fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an interior pixel angle estimated at 55 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 20% of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge, with several distinct notches and jagged peaks visible against the water interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the leading edges sweeping to a jagged, nearly horizontal trailing edge profile that terminates at a sharp central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/pinkish pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of overlapping, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying thickness and length distributed across the dark ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns including multiple sets of parallel rake marks and significant biological colonization (barnacles) at the fluke extremities.
